name: MegalogicStudio Wholesale Pricing for FluentCart
author: megalogicstudio

sections.description:
Set a wholesale price for each product variation, assign the Wholesale Customer role to selected users, and apply it through the product, cart, checkout, order, coupon, tax, shipping, and refund flows.

This plugin is an independent third-party extension for FluentCart and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FluentCart team.

Features

  • A Wholesale Customer role is available after activation.
  • Set wholesale prices for simple products and individual variations.
  • Keep retail prices for shoppers without the wholesale role.
  • Use the store’s normal cart, checkout, coupon, tax, shipping, order, and refund handling.
  • See integration compatibility status in the WordPress dashboard.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or later.
  • PHP 8.1 or later.
  • FluentCart Free 1.6.6. Wholesale pricing pauses for other or undetected versions.

Privacy

MegalogicStudio Wholesale Pricing does not send data to external services and does not include tracking or telemetry. Product prices are stored as WordPress product metadata.

Known Limitations

  • Compatibility verification currently covers WordPress 7.1.2 and FluentCart Free 1.6.6; other integration versions pause wholesale pricing.
  • Full page cache and third party CDN configurations must vary or bypass logged-in wholesale pages; universal compatibility is not claimed.
  • Custom themes, custom checkout templates, and other FluentCart versions have not been tested.
  • The plugin provides role based pricing only. Quantity tiers, approvals, quotes, and payment terms are not included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate FluentCart Free 1.6.6.
  2. Upload and activate MegalogicStudio Wholesale Pricing for FluentCart.
  3. Edit a product and enter wholesale prices in the Wholesale prices panel.
  4. Edit a WordPress user and assign the Wholesale Customer role.
sections.faq:
How do I enable wholesale pricing for a customer?

Edit the WordPress user and select Wholesale Customer as the user’s role.

What happens when the required integration is inactive or another version is installed?

Wholesale price filters remain paused. Administrators see a compatibility notice in the dashboard.

Does MegalogicStudio Wholesale Pricing collect or transmit site or customer data?

No. The plugin does not include analytics, telemetry, or external tracking.

Does it work with every page cache or CDN?

No universal cache compatibility is claimed. Since wholesale and retail visitors see different prices, configure full page caches to bypass or vary cached product and cart pages for logged-in users. Third-party CDN behavior has not been tested.
